ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 40% high-intensity (cream/white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous regions are located centrally in each lobe. The left lobe contains a cleaner, more uniform cream-colored polygon. The right lobe contains a high-intensity region with significant low-intensity stippling and mottling along its trailing margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 40 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:2.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along both lobes. The left lobe trailing edge features approximately 5 distinct peaks. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a more jagged, irregular topography with a deeper notch approximately 75% of the distance from the center to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges sweeping upward and outward to sharpened distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixels (calcifications/barnacles) are concentrated at both distal tips. A single circular white scar is also visible in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe's high-intensity region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear disruptions. The left lobe features 3-4 thin, dark diagonal lines. The right lobe displays approximately 6 prominent vertical dark lines (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular growth or mass of calcified tissue on the extreme left distal tip; series of vertical rake marks on the right lobe; distinct circular depigmentation spot on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme left tip exhibits a unique 'clumped' protrusion of high-contrast white and brownish pixels, distinct from the smoother contour of the right tip.
